mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 1.0%) compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This relationship holds across monetary policy cycles as long as the rate remains in the low range.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes a corporate earnings slowdown and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction permits (HOUST) and a contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a weakening demand environment, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue growth expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals an impending supply-side slowdown, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy approaches a peak.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the year-over-year CPI (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% triggers a monetary policy tightening expectation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors adjust to higher inflation risks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%, or the Rank IC is negative over a 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 (relative to 2017=100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate profits face headwinds.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In active monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%), a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the economy adjusts to higher interest rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0% and RSAFS declines, or the Rank IC for the regime is below 0.04.
